classification: PROJECT SCRIPTED-CONTROL CONVENTION — not fly physiology

matched non-looming/static-size.purpose: match standard looming theoretical peak angular size while removing expansion

outside_stimulus_window: visual threat features are exactly zero

seed.paired_trials: all normal and intervention comparisons use the same complete reset and seeds

normal_candidate_criteria.no-threat: DNp01 spike count = 0 and escape command count = 0
normal_candidate_criteria.standard looming: DNp01 spike count >= 1, command count >= 1, and first command strictly before 600 ms
normal_candidate_criteria.input_dependence: standard looming response signature differs from both static-size and receding
response_signature: first DNp01 spike logical neural tick or null
normal_candidate_criteria.finite_state: voltage and synaptic current finite throughout
normal_candidate_criteria.recovery: no DNp01 spikes and no new escape command during 700 <= t <= 800 ms

authority_criteria.output_clamp: zero escape commands and complete neural state trace identical to paired normal trial
authority_criteria.pathway_intervention: DNp01 response differs in total count, ordered first-spike tick by at least one neural tick, or response presence
authority_criteria.selection: first complete passing combination in primary-grid order

neighborhood: report only immediately adjacent values already in the primary grid
